steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires candidates to meet education and project-management experience thresholds before applying. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions from anywhere, learn directly from active certified practitioners, and earn all required contact hours. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your training, submit your official PMP application to PMI, including proof of your 35 contact hours and project experience documentation. Pay the exam fee at registration. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center convenient to you. Test-day success depends on focused preparation across all five PMI process groups.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or on-the-job project leadership. Renew before expiration to keep your credential active and competitive in Fairfield's project-driven employers.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
